findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand_position, get_ratings · Public sink: get_brand_position, get_brand_rates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand_position, get_ratings · Public sink: get_brand_position, get_brand_rates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Events (concerts, sport, conferences, festivals, with venue, expected attendance and when our research first saw them) and public and school holidays for an airport's city and country over a date range. Default: today to 90 days ahead." → after: "Events (trade fairs, concerts, sport, festivals, with venue, expected crowd and whether the crowd flies in), public and school holidays, and news events (a ground stop, a strike, a storm, with what each did to rates) for an airport over a date range. For those inside the 14 pick-up days of this morn"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
